title: Recipe Ingredient Entity Extraction
description: NLP sequence labeling project using CRF to extract ingredients, quantities, and units from unstructured recipe text.
metric: 99.83% validation accuracy, Processed 9,990 Annotated Tokens Across 280 Cleaned Recipe Records
insights: Ingredient Extraction Achieved 100% F1 Score with Zero Misclassifications
Class Imbalance Was the Primary NLP Modelling Challenge
Rich Feature Engineering Contributed More to Performance Than Model Complexity
